text: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Sydney. Which public liability lawyers are best?

result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Sydney. Which public liability lawyers are best?
result.markdown:
If you slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Sydney, you will want to look for accredited personal injury or **public liability specialists**. Shopping centre claims (against major retail groups, centre management, or cleaning contractors) can be complex because you have to prove negligence—such as showing that management failed to clean up a spill in a reasonable timeframe or lacked proper safety systems.

Most reputable public liability firms in Sydney operate on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis and offer a free initial consultation to evaluate your case.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-sydney#:~:text=View%20more%20Sydney%20Lawyers.%20We%20are%20the,your%20case.%20No%20Win%2C%20No%20Fee%20Lawyers.)

### Well-Known Public Liability Firms in Sydney

* **Law Partners:** One of the largest specialist personal injury firms in Australia, they handle a high volume of slip-and-fall claims against major supermarkets (Coles, Woolworths, Aldi) and shopping centres (like Westfield).[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/public-liability-lawyers/supermarket-injury#:~:text=We%20have%20extensive%20experience%20with%20Coles%2C%20Woolworths%2C,whether%20your%20claim%20is%20likely%20to%20succeed.)
* **Slater and Gordon:** A large national firm with a strong Sydney presence (CBD and suburban offices) specializing in public liability and slip-and-fall incidents.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-sydney#:~:text=Call%201800%20444%20141.%20Start%20your%20online,Parramatta%2C%20Penrith%2C%20Blacktown.%20Not%20in%20the%20Sydney%3F)
* **Stacks Goudkamp:** A well-regarded boutique personal injury firm in Sydney known for handling complex public liability and shopping centre/supermarket negligence claims.
* **Garling & Co:** A Sydney-based practice specialising heavily in slips, trips, and falls claims across NSW.
* **Wyatts Lawyers / PK Simpson:** Established NSW personal injury firms that frequently handle retail and shopping precinct accident claims.

---

### Critical Next Steps & Things to Keep in Mind

When choosing a lawyer and preparing your claim, keep these immediate priorities in mind:

1.  **Act Quickly (CCTV Evidence):** Shopping centres and supermarkets usually overwrite their CCTV footage after 30 to 90 days.[stacksgoudkamp.com.au](https://stacksgoudkamp.com.au/services/public-liability/supermarket-and-shopping-centre-injury-claims/#:~:text=Early%20action%20is%20crucial%20because%20CCTV%20footage,supermarket%20or%20shopping%20centre%20injury%20compensation%20claim.) A good lawyer will act fast to formally request the preservation of CCTV footage and incident reports.
2.  **Time Limits:** In New South Wales, there is generally a **3-year time limit** from the date of the accident to file a public liability claim in court, though it is always best to start much sooner while evidence is fresh.[wyattscompensationlawyers.com.au](https://wyattscompensationlawyers.com.au/public-liability-claim/supermarket-shopping-claims/#:~:text=Most%20claims%20must%20be%20lodged%20within%203,our%20compensation%20lawyers%20to%20start%20your%20case.)
3.  **Understand "No Win, No Fee":** While most firms won’t charge legal fees if you lose, be sure to ask whether their policy also covers **disbursements** (out-of-pocket costs like medical reports and court filing fees) if the case is unsuccessful.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-sydney#:~:text=View%20more%20Sydney%20Lawyers.%20We%20are%20the,your%20case.%20No%20Win%2C%20No%20Fee%20Lawyers.)
